hints.title: Square Sequence Progression
hints.text: A streak consists of values x, x^2, x^4, x^8, and so forth.

hints.title: Set Membership Lookup
hints.text: Insert all numbers into a collection with fast lookup to test consecutive square existence.

hints.title: Avoid Redundant Chain Traversal
hints.text: For each element, repeatedly check if its square exists in the collection, tracking length while square <= 100000.

hints.title: Square Streak Tracking Implementation

complexity.notes: Each square chain has at most 5 elements since 2^16 > 100,000.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all permutations of subsequences is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory to store numbers in hash set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that streak lengths are strictly capped at 5 and verifies chain membership efficiently.
